description: This file defines a Tiptap extension 'blockId' that manages block-level identifiers in a rich text editor, including global attribute setup and a ProseMirror plugin for automatic ID assignment.

classes.name: BlockId
classes.description: A Tiptap extension that adds and manages block IDs for various node types, including automatic ID generation and HTML attribute handling.

methods.name: addGlobalAttributes
methods.description: Defines global attributes for block node types, adding a 'blockId' attribute that is parsed from and rendered to HTML.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds a ProseMirror plugin that automatically assigns unique IDs to block nodes when the document changes.
